wth.text: Sisay, orphaned when Phyrexians raided her village, set out to gather the Legacy, knowing only that it could kill the Lord of the Wastes, Yawgmoth.

She joined the crew of the Burning Vengeance after slavers captured her, inherited the Weatherlight when its family was killed, and gathered a crew that came to include Tahngarth, Gerrard, Rofellos and Mirri.
Then Starke betrayed her to Volrath, delivering her to the Stronghold to lure Gerrard to Rath and free his daughter, and the crew traveled to Rath to rescue her.
Starke switched sides and guided the crew through the Stronghold, and they fled to the Weatherlight and escaped through the portal to Mercadia.

tmp.text: Sisay was betrayed by Starke, a servant of the Phyrexians, who captured her along with the Legacy.
Volrath had arranged her abduction to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, where he ambushed it, and Gerrard later led the ship there, freed Sisay and retook the Legacy from Volrath.
The Weatherlight then crashed on Mercadia, where Sisay gathered artifacts to repair the ship and led the oppressed peoples to a change of regime.

exo.text: Sisay, rescued with pieces of the Legacy, was injured, and she asked about her ship, which Gerrard assured her was intact.

uds.text: Sisay's parents were among thousands killed when the Phyrexians launched a preemptive strike on the sites of the academy's bloodline project, which had manipulated marriages between families strong in white mana, including her ancestors.

mmq.text: On Mercadia, Sisay asked to return to Mercadia City, and she, Hanna and Orim were sent to Saprazzo to get the Power Matrix in exchange for a stay of execution for Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn.
After Orim healed the dying Sisay, Gerrard and Sisay ran deeper into the mountain, unwilling to leave without the Weatherlight and crew.
In the end Sisay was restored, the Legacy recovered, and the Weatherlight sailed for Dominaria.

apc.text: Sisay discovered that the Weatherlight's mirrored hull could be used as a defensive weapon, while the ship entered Rath's atmosphere to rescue her, led by Gerrard.
The rescue party found only a shapeshifter in her place, since the Stronghold was the prison of Captain Sisay.
When the Weatherlight was absorbed in the completed Legacy, Dominarians granted Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee a new ship, the Victory.

plc.text: In Planar Chaos, Starke tells Sisay that he knows the Legacy is the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes, and he names his price: his daughter.

Sisay agrees to help rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy, but Starke betrays her by opening a portal at Volrath's command, from which massive hands drag her away.
Tahngarth later tells Gerrard they came to find him because something terrible has happened to Sisay.

m21.text: Sisay appears on this set's cards as the author of Memoirs.
